state.purpose: Attack the commoditization weakness of cloud-cost watch without sacrificing fast time-to-cash or low owner time. Optimize for highest realized owner hourly earnings reached quickly.

marketEvidence: CloudZero publicly positions AI unit economics as cost per customer, transaction, API call, feature, team or product and supports CSV/API unit metrics.
CloudZero positions AI cost observability as connecting inference/cloud spend to business dimensions and outcomes.
Vantage publicly discusses FinOps for AI token costs and AI workload spend monitoring.
These facts prove competition as well as demand; generic cost dashboards are not a differentiated offer.

candidates.name: cloud-cost-watch-baseline
candidates.claim: Customer provides recurring read-only cloud/AI billing exports. Engine detects anomalies, idle/waste patterns, concentration and quantified savings opportunities. Customer executes all effects and returns realized savings. One paid snapshot converts to monthly monitoring.

candidates.name: AI-unit-economics-snapshot
candidates.claim: An AI product company exports LLM/provider billing, model/workflow usage, and one existing business-unit metric such as customer, transaction, accepted run, or feature usage. Without installing a platform, the engine returns cost per unit, margin-risk segments, anomalies and prioritized optimize, reprice, investigate or retire recommendations. Customer executes all effects. Start with a fixed paid forensic snapshot from files, then recurring monitoring only if the same exports can be repeated.

candidates.name: AI-customer-margin-gate
candidates.claim: An AI product company exports provider/model costs plus existing customer revenue or plan data and customer/workflow attribution. The engine identifies customers/features where AI cost erodes gross margin and returns standardized keep, reprice, limit, optimize or investigate recommendations. No production routing or model changes are executed. Start with one paid gross-margin snapshot; recurring monitoring uses the same file contract.

candidates.name: AI-cost-of-quality-gate
candidates.claim: An AI product company exports model/provider cost plus its own existing accepted/rejected outcome or eval result by workflow. The engine reports cost per accepted outcome and identifies workflows where cheaper model/provider/prompt alternatives are worth controlled testing. It does not run production changes. Start with one paid snapshot, then recurring monitoring if the same evidence is available.

constraints: No full observability or FinOps platform build before paid evidence.
No production routing or infrastructure change authority.
Customer must already possess any business/outcome metric required by the offer.
